product_metadata.title: Signature Design by Ashley Shellmond Rustic Distressed Metal Accent Cocktail Table with Lift Top 20", Gray
features: FARMHOUSE COFFEE TABLE: Awash with an antiqued galvanized metal finish, this coffee table exudes rustic quality thanks to inspiration from classic metal tubs. It's signature farmhouse design
HANDSOMELY CRAFTED: Top is made of veneers and engineered wood. Designed with a split hinged lift top that reveals open storage. Metal base has an antiqued galvanized metal finish
SPLIT HINGED LIFT TOP: The lift top makes it easy to stow away living room items. Plus, galvanized metal against the wood top punctuates with distressed, rich allure—iconic in modern farmhouse
EXTRA STORAGE: Measuring 26" W x 26" D x 19.75" H, this center cocktail table looks great in large or small spaces. Set your favorite decor accents atop, and store throws or catchalls inside.
ASSEMBLY REQUIRED: Simply attach feet using the included instructions and hardware, and it's ready to enjoy
DIRECT FROM THE MANUFACTURER: Ashley Furniture goes the extra mile to package, protect and deliver your purchase in a timely manner
BUY WITH CONFIDENCE: Designed and manufactured by Ashley Furniture Industries. The trusted source for stylish furniture, lighting, rugs, accessories and mattresses. For every taste and budget
description: The classic galvanized metal tub—with a new sense of purpose. Sporting a split lift wood top that allows for handy storage, this round coffee table is sure to add a uniquely charming touch to your modern farmhouse. From sculptures to decorative trays to flower vases, coffee tables can hold just about anything. With a wide variety of styles and materials, our coffee tables are a great option if you need durability and versatility. Whatever your needs, we have something just right for you that will bring your space to life. And we go the extra mile to package, protect and deliver your purchase in a timely manner.
